source.note: single-card witness of the SOUGHT HOLE 'cost-modification' (priority 1 in rollup/port-topology.cited.json holes; proposed_stem=modification:spell, kind=BEHAVIOR, slang=[tax, cost-reduction, cheat-out], note: 'both directions (up tax / down reduction) homeless'). Per ACCRETION.md the corpus demand of this ENABLER hole reads ~0 (payoff-invisible), so its panel PRIORITY (1, most-corroborated) governs the pick, not the 0. Stone Calendar is the SMALLEST honest unit for the down (cost-reduction) direction: its ONLY ability is the cost modifier. Oracle (whole card): 'Spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.' AST is faithful, not a wish (hand-parsed gold at Fixtures/HandParsedCards/StoneCalendar.json): a single Ability.Kind=static with one Effect EffectType=costReduction, Amount={QuantityType:literal, Value:1} (purely generic {1}), AffectedObjects={CardTypes:[spell], Controller:You}. The ADR-2 layer projects the cost modifier as emit:costreduction; ADR-3 canonical stem = the bare modification:spell (the hole's proposed_stem). AXIS QUESTION (surfaced, not decided): the hole's proposed attr 'cost-delta' (which would carry the modification DIRECTION down/reduction, the AMOUNT {1}, and the CURRENCY mana) is NOT in the closed attribute_axes set. There is a 'delta' axis but it is signed-magnitude P/T on modification:creature (values_seen +X/-X), a different concept from a mana-cost delta. Following the Boggart Brute precedent (witness the bare modification:evasion, surface the evasion-kind axis rather than invent one), this gold witnesses the bare stem with ONLY the closed 'control' axis (control=you, from AffectedObjects.Controller=You) and does NOT invent a cost-delta key. The scaffold question (does modification:spell need a closed 'cost-delta' axis carrying {direction, amount, currency}?) is surfaced for scaffold refinement, not decided. SUPERGROUP caveat also surfaced: the modification supergroup def ('an object altered in place: P/T, keyword/ability grant, type/color/control change') does not yet mention casting-cost adjustment (CR 601.2f) as a modification target; modification:spell stretches it and the def may want a follow-up. No edhrec_rank in the testbed source, so source.popularity is omitted (not fabricated).
